title: Vallée's assessment of the Billy Meier photos

tellings.quote: but Jacqu Valet has looked at some of these photos.

plain: In the late 1970s, a Swiss man named Billy Meier put out photographs that he said showed alien spacecraft, and according to the researcher and philosopher Jason Jorjani, the computer scientist and longtime UFO researcher Jacques Vallée studied some of them. Jorjani says only that "Jacques Vallée has looked at some of these photos". He mentions it as an expert's look at some much-argued-over pictures, and he does not say what Vallée concluded.
